title: Research Notes
summary: Interact and pass DC 14 Intelligence to uncover Thisobald’s hidden ingredient stash.

fields.Investigation: The book triggers narration. A successful DC 14 Intelligence check reveals the stash on the map. The parcel contains Corpse Rose petals for Thisobald’s Brewed-Up Bellyglummer.
fields.Acquisition: Behind a locked door at the Waning Moon, X −257, Y −83.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay details with pinned item and linked rules evidence.
